Morning rush, the grinder's hum
Another day has just begun
Steam swirls up, a hazy dream
Serving coffee, a gentle stream
Faces blur, a hurried pace
Finding beauty in this place
A quick glance at the clock's soft chime
Stealing moments, stealing time

My notebook hidden out of sight
Waiting for the fading light
In this cafe I pour the brew
But my heart dreams of something new
A writer's soul, a hidden art
Playing out a different part
Beneath the surface words take flight
Chasing stories day and night

Lattes foam, a creamy art
Each cup a beat within my heart
A quiet smile, a whispered thanks
Building bridges, building banks
Of tiny moments, pure and true
Reflected in the morning dew
The afternoon begins to fade
My inner world, a serenade
Of verses waiting to be spun
Until the working day is done

In this cafe I pour the brew

Maybe one day the world will see
The hidden poet inside of me
These daily scenes, a source of grace
Finding rhythm in this space

As shadows lengthen in the sky
I wipe the counter, lock the door
And long for something, something more
